items.stem: Which TWO are good component-testing practices? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Mock network requests in unit tests
options.rationale: Correct: mocking keeps unit tests fast and deterministic.

options.text: Use findBy/await for content that appears asynchronously
options.rationale: Correct: async queries wait for the element to appear.

options.text: Call the production API in every test
options.rationale: Real network calls make tests slow and flaky.

items.explanation: Correct: mocking keeps unit tests fast and deterministic.

A query does not mock anything.
A failing query does not improve coverage.
